items.text: Javad Mojabi, an Iranian poet and writer, passed away on Saturday, 14 Shahrivar after a period of illness. He was born in 1939 in Qazvin and was active in literature and visual arts. Mojabi collaborated with various publications and published several works.

The European Union stated it is ready to take further measures to protect its security and interests, including freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. The EU spokesperson said the union shares the US view on Iran's destabilizing activities and is concerned about Iran's military cooperation with Russia. The EU has imposed extensive sanctions on Iran and supports US economic pressure efforts to stop Tehran's destabilizing actions.

Artin Khajouy-Nia, a 16-year-old computer student, was killed by live gunfire during protests in front of the city hall of Qods on January 8, 2026. His mother shared a video of his shoes from different periods of his life as keepsakes. She called her son her eternal hero and expressed her lasting memory of him.

CENTCOM destroyed three IRGC oil tankers after two US warships were targeted by Iran. These tankers financed the IRGC and its proxy forces. CENTCOM's commander warned they will not hesitate to defend US forces.

Carlos Tevez plans to hold his farewell match in December this year at La Bombonera stadium. Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi may play together on the same team for the first time in this match. Tevez intends to form his main team from his closest friends.

The US Central Command released a video showing attacks by the IRGC on three oil tankers and two US Navy warships. Two tankers are out of service and one tanker was destroyed in the Gulf of Oman. These attacks followed ballistic missile launches.

Mohammad Baqer Kharazi, a detained cleric, has been summoned to the Special Clergy Prosecutor's Office due to reports sent against him by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and other institutions. The concerns relate to his statements about domestic policy and hijab. The case is under investigation and the final decision rests with the judicial authority.

Ata Hosseinian explained the disagreements within the Islamic Republic government regarding the increase in gasoline prices. He said the government is forced to change the price and rationing due to the gasoline crisis. However, officials avoid taking responsibility for the social and political consequences of this decision.

Amid worsening economic crisis and security pressures, citizens have called for the fall of the government in messages to Iran International. They emphasize the need for street protests. Mohsen Mahimini explains the messages and officials' statements about a national revolution and repeated protests.

Nuzhat Mirrazi, the mother of two deceased protesters in Iran, was arrested in Lahijan and transferred to an unknown location. The arrest occurred one day after she released a video and amid increased security pressures in Gilan province. No information has been released about the detaining authority or possible charges.

The fleet development manager of the Road Maintenance Organization stated that out of 14,500 intercity buses, 8,600 are worn out and 3,000 are nearing wear. Additionally, 96% of active minibuses are worn out. There has been a more than 30% decrease in public transport passengers over the past three years.

Alireza Zakani, the mayor of Tehran, said that the United States has no limits and will always demand more regardless of what it is given. He also stated that so far, the actions of the Americans regarding the JCPOA have been against their commitments.

Abolhasan Fatemi, Khamenei's representative in Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari, stated that in this critical historical period, the presence of clerics in gatherings and religious sessions has become more necessary. He emphasized that people pay attention to the number of clerics present at events and judge accordingly.

A group of Iranians in Nuremberg, Germany, commemorated the memory of the eternal names with a performance and gathering. The event took place on September 5th. Organizers introduced the eternal names and expressed support for the Iranian national revolution in Germany.

Tasnim news agency reported that an Iranian tanker was attacked by the US military near Khark Island on Saturday morning, September 4, with no casualties. It was also reported that two other tankers near Jask were attacked by the US. CENTCOM stated that after ballistic missile launches by the IRGC, US forces targeted three Iranian tankers, one of which was destroyed.

The US Embassy in Bahrain issued a security alert on Saturday, September 5, asking American citizens to exercise increased caution due to the possibility of an 'unforeseen escalation' of tensions in the Middle East. The embassy stated that the Islamic Republic and its affiliated groups may target US interests and American citizens worldwide. This warning was issued hours before the announcement of a US attack on three Iranian oil tankers.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations center reported that several commercial ships in the northern Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman have been targeted by fire. These attacks occurred within the ongoing military activities in the region. The aim of the attacks was to disable the ships.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations announced that several commercial ships in the northern Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman were targeted by fire. The organization has received reports about these attacks but has not confirmed casualties or environmental impacts. Investigations are ongoing, and sailors are advised to follow security updates.

Fatemeh Mohajerani, the government spokesperson, described the December 1404 protests as the bitterest days of her career. She told Masoud Pezeshkian that despite no doubt about foreign interference, she does not really know the details of the matter. She also questioned how society reached a point where a security force member was martyred.

Asieh Amini commented on the compulsory attendance of students in schools and the opening of the Police High School. She said the government exploits students' situation for security and political goals instead of ensuring their safety. This statement refers to the military and security training of children.

The US Department of Defense denied a Reuters report about considering options to replace Deputy Secretary of Defense Steve Feinberg, stating no process is underway to replace him. The department added that it has "never had a better deputy." The White House and the Secretary of Defense also expressed support for Feinberg's performance.

Gol Gohar club protested against insulting chants directed at Omid Alishah during the match with Tractor. Spectators boo him every time he receives the ball. This is Alishah's first appearance in Tabriz wearing the Gol Gohar jersey.

The head of Kurdistan's emergency medical center announced that at least 11 people died following a tanker carrying fuel catching fire on the Sanandaj–Hamedan route. Additionally, five others were injured. This incident resulted in casualties and injuries.

Tractor football team defeated Gol Gohar Sirjan 1-0 in the sixth week of the Premier League and maintained its top position with 16 points. The only goal was scored by Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh. The match included controversies such as protests against refereeing and fans' chants.

The Al-Taher hill in southern Lebanon was captured by Israel. Two missile cities, Emad 2 and 4, under this hill fell to Israel. Hezbollah lost much of its ability to launch missile attacks on Israel on behalf of Tehran.

A fuel tanker exploded on the Sanandaj-Hamedan road, causing a fire that spread to several vehicles. So far, 11 people have died and 7 have been injured. Rescue and safety operations at the site are ongoing.

Fereydoun Haddad Adel stated in an interview that Ali Fadavi, a commander of the IRGC, confirmed that orders from Mojtaba Khamenei were approved by the leader. He added that Mojtaba Khamenei has been active in political, security, and military matters since June 1997 and has been an assistant to the leader. The leader has also said several times that Mojtaba is not just a son of the leader but is a leader himself.

Sohrab Bakhtiyari-Zadeh, the head coach of Esteghlal, announced that Saleh Hardani has been excluded from team training due to unprofessional behavior and recent disorder. He stated that as long as he is coach, Hardani cannot attend training sessions. Bakhtiyari-Zadeh also mentioned that the main reason for this decision was Hardani's unprofessional conduct during a set-piece moment in the derby.

Wage and insurance arrears have been reported by daily wage workers at Iranshahr steam power plant, contract workers of Lorestan railway technical buildings, company forces of the Natural Resources Protection Unit in Sistan and Baluchestan, and laid-off workers of Saman Air Services Company. The report concerns four different units. More details are provided in the continuation of the report.

The spokesperson of Khatam al-Anbia Headquarters warned that if the US continues to harass Iranian ships, the armed forces will strike US military vessels more severely. The sounds heard in Jask and Qeshm were due to punishing violating vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. The US Secretary of Defense also warned that if Iran fires at American ships, Iranian oil tankers will be destroyed.

Mehdi Mahdavi-Azad stated in the program "Cheshmandaz" that the Islamic Republic, by increasing its threats and conditions in the Strait of Hormuz, has largely lost the credibility of its threats. He mentioned claims of closing the strait, demanding money, inspecting ships, and restricting the passage of US and Israeli ships. This process has reduced the credibility of the Islamic Republic's threats.

The Israeli army is preparing to reduce its forces and establish a new security line closer to the border after destroying tunnels in southern Lebanon. This line will replace the current security zone. The plan is not finalized yet, and the handover of evacuated areas is still under review.

Mehdi Shafakhah, an activist in education and support for working children, was sentenced to two years and three months in prison by Branch 29 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court. His charges include propaganda against the regime and insulting the leader. This news was reported by Harana News Agency.

Alireza Zakani stated that in the attack that led to the death of Ali Khamenei, his library and manuscripts were destroyed. So far, there is no news of his will. These remarks were made in response to a question about the will of the former leader of the Islamic Republic.

Ahmad Nadari stated that the Islamic Republic may carry out preemptive attacks to defend its interests if necessary. He said the Islamic Republic is prepared for full-scale war and reciprocal response. Additionally, it will deliver heavy and military responses if sanctions escalate.
Nurses and healthcare staff in Fasa held a protest due to unpaid wages for eight months. The protest took place today. They demand their outstanding payments.

Ahmad Alavi, an economist, does not consider the simultaneous rise in currency, gold, and coin prices as a temporary panic. He attributes this trend to reduced currency inflow, failure in oil sales, and pressure from sanctions. The currency price is expected to continue rising.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi said the Islamic Republic must either take military action or increase economic costs for Gulf countries to break the naval blockade, but has not succeeded so far. He added that the US economic blockade has intensified power divisions, weakened the Islamic Republic's negotiating position, and reduced its financial and military capabilities. Washington's strategy aims to pressure for negotiations while reducing the Islamic Republic's response capacity.

Vladimir Putin, the President of Russia, met with Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, special representatives of the United States, on Saturday, 14 Shahrivar, at the Kremlin. Putin said that contacts between Moscow and Washington have always been beneficial. Witkoff conveyed Donald Trump's message of thanks for establishing a ceasefire during the American delegation's visit.

The IRGC Navy announced that in response to the US attack on three Iranian oil tankers, it targeted three tankers in an unauthorized route and three American vessels. It did not provide details on the extent of damages or crew status. It also warned vessels in the Persian Gulf to avoid unauthorized routes and said any suspicious movement will be targeted.
Khoddad Azizi and Omid Alishah made harsh statements against each other after the sixth week match. They had a confrontation during the game. This issue has been reflected in the media.

The media manager of Gol Gohar club stated that Khodadad Azizi insulted Omid Alishah with offensive language after the match. The club has documented evidence and will pursue the matter through the federation's judicial bodies. Azizi said he responded to the insults.

The foreign ministers of Egypt and Oman discussed developments in the Strait of Hormuz and their impact on regional security and the global economy. They emphasized the need to protect shipping and ensure the flow of trade and energy transfer. The Egyptian foreign minister called for an end to tensions and the return of the US and Iran to negotiations.

Mohammad Qaedi said the US has so far targeted Iran's central bank and some small Chinese refineries but not major Chinese banks. Washington may refrain from escalating sanctions before the Trump-Xi Jinping meeting. If China does not cooperate, the next phase of sanctions could target major Chinese banks.

Due to incidents in the fourth week of the Iranian Premier League, Chader-Malou club has been banned from having male spectators. The sixth-week match will be held only with female spectators. This measure aims to increase women's presence in stadiums.

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps released a video showing attacks on commercial ships and oil tankers of various countries in the Strait of Hormuz. This video was broadcast by media supporting the Islamic Republic. No further details about the attacks were provided.

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced that its aerospace force targeted a US aircraft carrier and a destroyer with ballistic missiles. These ships were involved in the naval blockade of Iranian vessels and were damaged and left the area after the attack. The IRGC warned that if military pressures continue, broader responses will follow.
CENTCOM released a video of an oil tanker sinking in the Gulf of Oman. The video mentions that the tanker joined the Iranian Navy at the bottom of the sea. This news was announced by CENTCOM.

Jacob Nagel, head of Israel's National Security Council, said sustained economic pressure for 6 to 9 months could create conditions for an effective popular uprising in Iran. He added that the US is pursuing an economic pressure strategy instead of immediate military attacks. Washington aims to weaken the Islamic Republic by targeting its main revenue sources.

Araghchi held phone talks on Saturday evening with Turkish and Saudi counterparts about bilateral issues and regional developments. He also consulted on the latest diplomatic efforts to establish stability in the Strait of Hormuz. These contacts were conducted by telephone.

The Sunday Times reported that two luxury apartments linked to Mojtaba Khamenei in London have been put up for sale. These penthouses were purchased for £36 million by Ali Ansari. Ansari, who is accused of acting as an intermediary for Mojtaba Khamenei, was sanctioned by the US in July.

Farzin Nadimi, a defense expert, stated that the Islamic Republic does not have the capability to completely cut off maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. However, the IRGC can still disrupt shipping and damage some vessels. This statement concerns the missile, drone, and naval capabilities of the IRGC.

Habibollah Sayari said Trump repeatedly claims Iran has no nuclear weapons and faces economic problems. Sayari added that Iran's armed forces are working to enhance deterrence capabilities. He referred to past wars and stated efforts continue to strengthen strengths.

Fatemeh Azizkhani stated that the poverty line in 1405 will be about 32 million tomans nationwide and over 62 million tomans in Tehran. She warned that without an economic security network, even working households will fall below the poverty line. Additionally, increased security pressures to control labor protests have been reported.

Morteza Zamaniyan, Deputy Minister of Economy, announced the formation of an Economic War Headquarters to coordinate and quickly resolve economic issues. The initial focus of this headquarters is on the duties of the Ministry of Economy. The goal is to facilitate cooperation between agencies and prevent bureaucratic delays.

The Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated that it targeted a remotely controlled vessel of the US Army. The vessel intended to enter the protected area of the Strait of Hormuz. This news was released by the IRGC public relations.

Hossein Mohebbi, spokesperson for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, told Mehr News Agency that if the US wants to inflict one dollar of economic damage on Iran, it may incur several dollars in costs and losses itself. He added that Americans should know that intensifying the economic siege on Iran will only create more costs for themselves. Mohebbi stated that imposing economic pressure and creating a siege does not necessarily mean victory for the sanctioning side and can even bring heavy costs.

Reza Goharzad stated that the dispute over occupied territories remains a main issue in negotiations. He said recent pressures by Ukraine and the role of European countries could pave the way for renewed talks. These efforts aim to end the Russia-Ukraine war.

Arvin Salemi-rad was injured by direct shooting from the Islamic Republic's suppression forces during protests in Bushehr on January 8. He died 18 days later from the gunshot wounds. His memory remains a guiding light for freedom seekers.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing a long line of cars in front of a gas station. He says he was in line for gasoline from 1 AM to 5 AM. This citizen added that the gasoline ran out and they did not get any.

Omid Memarian, a political analyst, said that the Islamic Republic is trying to impose costs on the US by disrupting the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz. He added that if Iran cannot maintain this pressure, the balance of power will shift completely in favor of the US.

Fathollah Tavassoli stated that the US and Europe cannot weaken the Iranian nation through sanctions. He emphasized that Iran has resisted demands and continued its domestic progress and international cooperation. Economic pressures have increased internal cohesion and reduced trust in the West.

Hossein Aghaei from Iran International said that US attacks on Iranian oil tankers have approached Iranian ports and islands. This indicates a change in Washington's approach. The US may sink Iranian tankers if tensions continue.

People report their economic and social difficulties in the current situation in Iran. The costs of education and living have increased significantly, and families face serious financial problems. Concerns about school safety and the impact of military tensions have also been raised.

Ali Madanizadeh, the Minister of Economy, said that Iran has paid economic costs but will not surrender. He stressed that Iran's economy is run for the people's lives, not for Washington's satisfaction. He also said that the response to US pressure will be economic resistance and reforms, and that the future of Iran will be determined by its people.
A citizen sent a video showing a long line of cars in front of the Seyed Reza fuel station in Mashhad. The video was recorded on the evening of Saturday, September 4. The cars are in a winding queue.

Turkey has increased its diplomatic activities to reduce tensions between the US and the Islamic Republic. This report was prepared by Narges Horkhsh, a journalist from Iran International. The goal of these activities is to reduce existing tensions between the two countries.

Mehdi Chamran, head of Tehran City Council, stated that Lebanon and Hezbollah are the frontline and Israeli attacks must be responded to. He also said Netanyahu lies for elections and called for the overthrow of those cooperating with Israel. These remarks were made during a Tehran City Council meeting.

The Disciplinary Committee of the Football Federation issued a notice to Khodadad Azizi, the head of Tractor team, due to misconduct and misbehavior during the match against Gol Gohar. Azizi must submit his defense within 48 hours. Gol Gohar club claims that Azizi insulted one of their players with offensive language after the match.

Ruhollah Rahimpour stated that Tehran's 'tanker for tanker' approach has placed it in a strategic dilemma. Continuing attacks could lead to the loss of economic assets, while stopping attacks means losing control of the Strait of Hormuz. He described Abbas Araghchi's recent contacts as rescue diplomacy to prevent a regional coalition against Iran.

Roozbeh Gilasian, a writer from Gorgan, was sentenced to four years and eight months in prison by Branch One of the Revolutionary Court in Bandar Abbas. He was sentenced to eight months for propaganda against the regime and four years for educational or deviant propaganda activities. The sentence was issued on September 1st.

A group of Iranians living in Germany protested against executions by the Islamic Republic on Saturday, September 5, in Hamburg, Düsseldorf, and Frankfurt. They chanted "Long live the Shah." This event was reported based on videos received by Iran International.

Ali Madanizadeh, the Minister of Economy, responded to the US Treasury Secretary's remarks about intensifying sanctions. He stated that the economy is built by the people, not the US Treasury. These remarks were made in response to economic pressures against the Islamic Republic.

Several citizens in Karaj were arrested by security forces for supporting an opposition group. The arrests followed the release of a video showing their group moving with motorcycles and cars around Karaj.

Fereshteh Karimi, former Iranian women's futsal national player, has joined the Persepolis women's football team. After years in futsal, she decided to continue her career in football. This decision was made after consulting with the futsal national team coach.

A citizen sent a video showing that papers have been distributed in Basij centers. These papers allow Basij members to receive free bread by presenting them. Each presenter can receive up to 26 pieces of free bread.

In Mashhad, gas stations are crowded due to fuel shortages and reduced quotas. Prices of gasoline and essential goods like meat and gold have sharply increased. Additionally, new hijab enforcement orders have been reported, and the morality police vans have been reactivated.

Social security retirees in Ahvaz held a protest gathering. They demanded full implementation of Articles 96 and 111, correction of salary adjustment rulings, and an increase in pensions. They also highlighted their livelihood and healthcare problems.

The Jerusalem Post reported that Israeli intelligence assessments indicate that the Islamic Republic is trying to coordinate its proxy forces for a simultaneous attack on Israel. Benjamin Netanyahu announced that Israel will continue operations against the Islamic Republic. This issue was discussed in an interview with an Iran International reporter.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, the Speaker of the Parliament, stated that the era of proportional responses has ended and Iran's recent strikes were just the beginning. He warned that any aggression against Iran's interests and security will be met with faster, heavier, and more painful responses. Ghalibaf also mentioned economic challenges such as currency fluctuations, inflation, and unemployment that are putting pressure on people's livelihoods.

Ahmad Bakhshaish Ardestani stated that if the war prolongs, there is a possibility of the US using a nuclear bomb and Trump is willing to take that risk. He also commented on Iran's orientation towards the East and the current economic conditions. The parliament is working to double the amount of ration coupons.

Nahid Nafisi, head of the National Breast Surgery Association, reported 23,000 to 25,000 new annual breast cancer cases in Iran. The average age of onset in Iran is about 48 to 50 years, which is 10 years younger than the global average. She also mentioned the increasing trend of incidence and related factors.

A group of young job seekers from the villages of Moran and Amisheh in Khuzestan province protested for the tenth consecutive day in front of the Dabbol Khazaei Agro-Industry Company. They are protesting the failure to prioritize the employment of local forces. The protest took place on Sunday, September 6.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that the era of proportional responses has ended. He said any aggression against the interests and security of the Islamic Republic will be met with a faster, heavier, and more painful response. Ghalibaf added that the recent attacks on US bases were only the beginning.

Teachers gathered in front of the Planning and Budget Organization in Tehran on Sunday, 15 Shahrivar. They protested low salaries, livelihood problems, and decreased purchasing power. A video of this gathering was sent to Iran International.

Saeed Laylaz stated that the country cannot be governed with hesitation and the government must make decisive decisions. He described economic reforms as necessary and painful and warned that increasing fuel prices without controlling liquidity growth could lead to social protests. He also said that confrontation with the US and maintaining the satisfaction of all social classes is impossible.

Mostafa Moeini Arani, the representative of Kashan, described unveiled and improperly veiled behavior as a serious social problem and called for its prevention. He urged officials not to let the sacrifices of martyrs be in vain. He also requested Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf to enforce the hijab and chastity law.

The New York Times reported that Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz continue after more than six months of war. The oil passage through the Strait is about 60% lower than before the war. US protective operations since late April have helped the passage of thousands of ships and millions of barrels of oil.

A citizen sent a video showing a group of government supporters waving flags at a nighttime gathering. He says the number of these people is small and they are government dependents. The video was published by Iran International.

An official in Israel's National Security Council stated that the Islamic Republic has increased efforts to target opponents, journalists, Jews, and Israelis abroad. Operational units are active in various countries and exploit the lack of full security support for opponents. The official also mentioned the Islamic Republic's revenge efforts following the killing of Ali Khamenei and senior officials.

Mehdi Moslehi described the gasoline crisis in Iran as a result of distribution and economic problems. He stated that the Islamic Republic cannot blame gasoline shortages on consumer usage. He also pointed to the lack of options for fuel-efficient vehicles and public transportation.

Saeed Shiayi, a 17-year-old teenager detained during the nationwide protests of December 2025, was released on bail from the Mashhad Correction and Rehabilitation Center. He is a resident of Sabzevar. The news was reported by the HRANA news agency.

A worker on the Ahvaz metro project set himself on fire in front of the city hall due to five months of unpaid wages and dismissal. He was rescued by other workers and taken to the hospital. This incident occurred on the morning of Sunday, September 6.

The father of Ilya Ojaqloo protested the destruction of his son's tombstone by removing the picture of his brothers killed in the Iran-Iraq war. Ilya Ojaqloo, 18 years old, was shot and killed on the evening of January 8, 2026, in front of Sabzeh Meydan police station in Zanjan.

Xabi Alonso and Mikel Arteta, childhood friends and rivals, now face each other as managers of Chelsea and Arsenal in the English Premier League. Both coaches grew up in San Sebastián and the Antiguoko club, a key center for developing football coaches. The culture of competition and the Basque people's passion for sports played an important role in shaping this generation of coaches.

Gol Gohar Sirjan club has protested the lack of a temporary order against Khodadad Azizi. The club stated it will pursue the insulting behaviors of Azizi during and after the match against Tractor through legal channels. They have the original audio file attributed to him and will submit it to the relevant authorities for investigation.

The head of the Welfare Organization announced the identification of 2,088 out-of-school children among those under the organization's coverage. Additionally, about four thousand child laborers in Tehran have been organized. These figures relate to the status of child laborers and out-of-school children.

The commander of North Khorasan's IRGC announced the revival and reconstruction of verbal reminder groups in the province. These groups aim to promote Islamic values, modesty, and hijab. Additionally, cultural billboards and advertising structures will be installed throughout the city.

CENTCOM announced that US forces have redirected 92 commercial ships and disabled three ships by September 5. They have boarded two ships to ensure compliance with the blockade. A stealth F-35 fighter also patrolled the waters during the blockade.
Ezzatollah Zarghami stated that due to Ahmad Jannati's advanced age, it is not possible to meet or talk with him. He added that no one dares to discuss Jannati's condition.

A 34-year-old protester in Qazvin was severely injured by live ammunition during the December protests. He has undergone five surgeries and is still receiving treatment. His family has pursued part of the treatment secretly and at great expense due to security concerns.

A citizen in a video to Iran International says they eat chicken feet for dinner due to severe price increases. He expressed dissatisfaction with the economic situation. The video reflects people's concerns about inflation.

Mehdi Chamran, head of Tehran City Council, stated that Iran should not allow attacks and must act preemptively. He emphasized that the Islamic Republic should respond to US actions with unity and resistance. He also expressed regret that such a person is the president of the United States.

Ali Manouchehrabadi, 21 years old, died in Tehran due to direct shooting by officers. His mother lit a candle in the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" in his memory. She said her son was the foundation that could have built his homeland.

The head of the Cinema House board reported an increase in summons and case formations for filmmakers after the recent war. Even sharing or liking certain images on social media has led to case formations. The Cinema House's protest was sent to Masoud Pezeshkian and referred to the head of the judiciary and the Culture and Media Prosecutor's Office for review.

Mostafa Moeini Arani, representative of Kashan, described the state of hijab as a deep wound on society. He requested the parliament speaker to notify the government president about the hijab and chastity law. Additionally, Mohammad Seraj mentioned the activity of malicious elements promoting immorality.
